_comment: As run11 but with the masterConfig DEFAULT cm-class crosslink (thermal 0.01 m, delay-cal constant 0.01 m = 33 ps). This is the configuration docs/federated_swarm_architecture.md section 7 Finding B measured at 1.3 cm solved baseline / 4.6 cm shape. Included to show what the architecture delivers when the crosslink hardware is calibrated, i.e. the payoff of fixing the per-link delay bias rather than inflating sigma to hide it. NOTE: the federated relative-CLOCK layer is left OFF because multiAsset.twoWayTimeTransferISL.enable is hard-blocked by validateMasterConfig:legacySatelliteTimeTransfer while SwarmRelativeSolver still reads that path — the clock half of the relative layer is orphaned. Shape is the beamforming question and its gate is unaffected.
